description: Karnataka Chief Minister D K Shivakumar directs officials to collaborate with tech giant Google to introduce artificial intelligence lessons for students starting from Class 6 in government schools across the state.
body_lead: AI education in schools: Karnataka plans to rope in Google In Karnataka, AI education has started for Class 9 students in government schools. CM asked officials to work with the Information Technology Department to start AI education from Class 6. Karnataka Chief Minister D K Shivakumar
